scene_description: A classroom with a smiling teacher, Ms. Smith, standing at a green chalkboard with math problems, while several students sit at desks with their hands raised.

questions.question: What do you think Ms. Smith will do next after seeing all the students raise their hands?
What do you think Ms. Smith asked the class right before everyone raised their hands?
What is your favorite subject to learn about in school, or do you like math?
What else could Ms. Smith be teaching the students about today instead of math?
What feelings do you think the students have when they know the answer to a question?
